name: ltx25_i2v
title: Image to video · LTX-2.5
description: Animate a still you own into a 1 to 10 second clip with sound. The still becomes the first frame.

image.label: Start frame
image.help: Name returned by the backend's /upload/image, not a local path.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.help: Start with 'Use the provided start image as the first frame.' then describe the move.

negative.default: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly
negative.label: Negative prompt

aspect.label: Aspect ratio
aspect.help: Match the still's shape; the frame is resized to fit.

motion.label: Motion
motion.help: Image conditioning strength on the first pass. Lower keeps the still intact.
